strings.name: Jorge Paulo Lemann
strings.summary: Lemann moved from banking into the businesses associated with Garantia, Ambev and 3G Capital, investing with longtime partners in beer, restaurants and food. His approach emphasizes cost discipline, management and long-term ownership; his foundation supports Brazilian education. The Americanas accounting crisis raised governance questions, but company investigations or partners’ cases are not a personal conviction.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Helped establish 3G Capital and invested in global consumer companies, influencing cross-border acquisitions and management practices.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born 26 August 1939 in Rio de Janeiro; Brazilian and Swiss citizen.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.highlights.h1.title: Consumer-business acquisitions
strings.highlights.h1.text: Invested with partners across brewing, restaurants and food, building international operating networks.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Education philanthropy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Founded the Lemann Foundation in 2002 to support Brazilian education and public leadership.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Skechers acquisition completed
strings.timeline.t1.text: 3G Capital completed the Skechers acquisition through investment funds and management teams.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Americanas accounting crisis
strings.timeline.t2.text: The longtime portfolio retailer disclosed accounting problems and entered restructuring, raising governance questions.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Heinz transaction
strings.timeline.t3.text: 3G partnered with Berkshire Hathaway to acquire Heinz.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Burger King transaction
strings.timeline.t4.text: 3G acquired Burger King, expanding global restaurant investments.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Global investment platform
strings.timeline.t5.text: Helped establish 3G Capital; Ambev and Interbrew also combined into InBev that year.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Ambev formation
strings.timeline.t6.text: Helped combine Brahma and Antarctica, developing the Brazilian brewing business.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Garantia bank
strings.timeline.t7.text: Established investment-banking operations with partners and developed management and transaction experience.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Harvard education
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed undergraduate economics studies before entering finance.
